note: Labels, typical speeds and practical rates per type are rules of thumb; min_bend_radius_mm values are placeholder engineering estimates.

types.label: Roller (MDR)
types.notes: Motor-driven rollers (24 V motor roller per zone, run on demand): totes, bins and cartons with firm flat bottoms; accumulation (ZPA) and buffering. The smallest item must sit on at least 3 rollers. ~2,400 units/h per line.

types.label: Belt
types.notes: Full surface support: polybags, apparel, small and fragile items, long runs, inclines and declines. Transport only: a plain belt cannot accumulate. 3,000+ units/h.

types.label: Modular plastic belt
types.notes: Link-plate / modular-tab belt surface on sprockets: wet or heavy duty, tight curves.

types.label: Omni-wheel sorter deck
types.notes: Deck of powered omni wheels: goods can be steered in any direction (its merges, diverters and transfers get the wheel deck too).

types.label: Pouch sorter (overhead)
types.notes: Overhead rail with trolleys carrying hanging pouches (pocket sorter: Ferag Skyfall, Dürkopp, Knapp, TGW): one item per pouch, sorted by rail switches. The pouch is a standard 400 x 600 mm bag or a custom size, set per line.

types.label: Right-Angle Transfer (RAT)
types.notes: Discrete inserted module, not a bent path -- a powered transfer head lifts/diverts product 90 degrees.

types.label: Merge / Transfer Junction
types.notes: Auto-generated when two paths' endpoints snap together; can be swapped for a different module type afterward.

types.label: Diverter / Sorter
types.notes: Basic skewed-roller-style diverter module. Full sortation logic is out of scope for v1.
